part.text:
Confirmed: on the original code the same suite had 98 passing / 4 failing — including those same two environmental failures ("max content length" 400 and "HTTPS protocol" network timeout). With the fix, both new tests pass and no regression remains.

## Fix

The bug was in `lib/core/AxiosHeaders.js`: `normalizeValue` stringified every value with `String(value)`, so a `set-cookie` array from `parseHeaders` or Node's `res.headers` was joined into a single comma-separated string when stored via `set()`, and `toJSON()` unconditionally joined arrays.

Changes (mirroring upstream v1.2.0):
- `normalizeValue` now preserves arrays: `utils.isArray(value) ? value.map(normalizeValue) : String(value)` — so `new AxiosHeaders(res.headers)` / `headers.get('set-cookie')` return an array of cookies (lib/core/AxiosHeaders.js:13).
- `toJSON(asStrings)` only joins arrays into strings when `asStrings` is explicitly requested (lib/core/AxiosHeaders.js:249).

Validation: `test/unit/core/AxiosHeaders.js` (incl. "should support array values") and `test/unit/regression/bugs.js` (issue 5028 set-cookie array) now pass; full mocha unit suite goes from 98 → 100 passing with the only 2 failures being pre-existing network/timing issues unrelated to the change.
